notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked; simulated R0, model-authored and unreviewed, reviewed_by null; no hardware run and no MHS-Device level claimed). The upstream stack (Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, IsaacLab-Arena, Python 3.11 per README.md:59, an NVIDIA RTX GPU per README.md:47-49 and USD assets downloaded from Hugging Face) was never started here. Native symbol: the card's make_tavis_env entry symbol is a function (make_env.py:14) and G7 resolves native as a class, so native names the card's GR1T2Embodiment entry symbol (gr1t2.py:400); the registered environment class is Isaac Lab's ManagerBasedRLEnv, external to the clone, and the returned wrapper is CanonicalFrameWrapper (make_env.py:99-100). The fake stands in for the registered environment, so G7 compares its Gymnasium interface with the embodiment class, whose base EmbodimentBase is also external: action_space, observation_space, reset and step are reported as G7.MAYBE_ABSENT warnings by design (the same pattern as the felipemohr__isaaclab-quadruped-tasks package). No fixed env_id exists: make_tavis_env registers the composed environment as tavis_env at build time (make_env.py:56-61 and :72-75), so the family's gym.make(env_id) path is not configured and the package provides only the fake backend. The fake is an F0 kinematic stand-in: a single 19-element unbounded action Box and one 19-number policy observation group (GR1T2 action layout, gr1t2.py:8-10), with no Isaac Sim physics, IK, contacts, actuators, sensors, noise, camera image, task reward, episode limit or canonical-frame conversion; the real action space is the batched 19-D Box of the composed action terms and the real observation is a Dict of groups including head-camera images, so the real arrays are larger. timestep_ms is 50 ms, the default 20 Hz control period (make_env.py:20); the fake advances an integer tick per step and models no simulated time. These reductions are in fidelity.gaps. Warnings are explained: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 is expected (the seed only sets the next reset); the four G7.MAYBE_ABSENT warnings are the interface/base mismatch described above; G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE is truthful because the clone states the 19-D action layout but no finite per-element action bound, so no limit is invented and the suite awards CL2 instead of CL3; the four G8.NO_UNIT warnings are the bridge-derived integer and action inputs. There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. No catalogue requests: only cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
